digest.component_or_area: documentation tooling and configuration reference generation
propositions: A new generator script must read config schema, deprecation registry, and secret names to produce authoritative generated configuration and security reference documentation.
The generator must emit both config-reference.md and security.md as fully-generated files with self-announcing banners, leaving docs/config.md untouched and its consumers intact.

Generated documentation must include coverage of all required topics (precedence, source, lifecycle, restart/redeploy rotation, native refresh, observability exception, subprocess limitations, behavior deltas, MCP/CLI exposure) verified by a topic-coverage test.
A --check drift mode must detect staleness in generated docs with newline-normalized comparison to avoid false failures on CRLF checkouts, running portably under make test.
Both generated docs and their generation command must be registered in test_generated_surface_markers.py and docs/README.md generated-files table to maintain parity gate compliance.
